note: Pad -> PLC input mapping. Device names are the PLC's own labels (octal numbering: X7 is followed by X10). Lanes are listed in the game's left-to-right order. In design v4 the pad state reaches these inputs through the Pico (GPIO -> opto module), NOT directly from the switches: the Pico sends the fast path to the PC as a USB keyboard and mirrors the same state to the PLC for lights/motor logic.
